title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E15 — The Battle of Bel Air
Reporter Tawnia Baker poses as a computer operator to help the team capture terrorists plotting to assassinate a sheik.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E16 — Say It With Bullets
A woman hires the team to investigate the murder of her brother, who was part of a munitions theft operation.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E17 — Pure-Dee Poison
The team helps a Southern minister (John Amos) break a ring selling poisonous moonshine; guests Bo Hopkins, Tracy Reed.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E18 — It's a Desert Out There
The team fights robbers, led by a bandit (Jeannie Wilson), who ambush tour buses leaving a run-down Nevada casino.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E20 — Kindred Spirits
Banner joins an archaeological dig to learn about a prehistoric Hulk; guests Kim Cattrall, A Martinez.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E18 — The Disciple
Banner's friend Li Sung (Mako) hands over the leadership of his group to a police officer; guests Rick Springfield, Gerald McRaney.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E17 — Mystery Man
Banner becomes the Hulk to save himself and McGee from a forest fire.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E21 — The Confession
Plagued by a young assistant, McGee finds a lonely young man who claims to be the Hulk; guest Markie Post.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E4 — The Slam
Arrested for vagrancy, Banner's fellow work-camp inmates accuse him of being an informer; guest Charles Napier.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E8 — No Big Thing
Jailed for a traffic infraction, Devon sees a cellmate murdered.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E9 — Trust Doesn't Rust
Two thieves unleash KITT's prototype KARR, programmed without an instruction to protect human life.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E1 — Problem
DeSoto is forced to give medical treatment without authorization when the radio link to the hospital is broken; guest Lloyd Bochner.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E2 — Kids
Brackett insists an injured boy is a child-abuse victim; the paramedics aid a trapped boy and a fallen hiker; guest Richard Jaeckel.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E3 — Show Biz
Gage is selected to be the model for an ideal firefighter; Brackett urges an aging doctor who has suffered a heart attack to retire.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E4 — Virus
A mysterious virus strikes Brackett, Gage and a firefighter; the paramedics aid a teenage vertigo victim; guest Cathy Lee Crosby.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E5 — Peace Pipe
The Rampart staff struggles to save a girl injured by a drunken driver; Gage's Indian heritage becomes the topic of a feud with Chet.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E6 — Saddled
The paramedics rescue the driver and passengers of a school bus that plunged over a cliff; Gage dreams of becoming a rich rodeo star.
